query:
INSERT INTO news (slug, title, excerpt, coverImageUrl, blocks, categoryId, date, publishedAt, createdAt)
VALUES (
  'utah-shakespeare-festival-2023-season',
  'Assistant Scenic Designer: Utah Shakespeare Festival 2023 Season',
  'Supporting Jo Winiarski''s scenic designs for Romeo and Juliet and A Midsummer Night''s Dream at the Utah Shakespeare Festival.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/AvXraUNuKJpnsGTe.jpg',
  '[{"type":"text","content":"The 2023 season at Utah Shakespeare Festival continued my collaboration with scenic designer Jo Winiarski, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for two of Shakespeare''s most beloved plays: the tragic romance *Romeo and Juliet* and the magical comedy *A Midsummer Night''s Dream*."},{"type":"header","content":"The Productions"},{"type":"text","content":"**Romeo and Juliet** brought Shakespeare''s timeless tragedy to life in the outdoor Engelstad Shakespeare Theatre. Jo Winiarski''s scenic design evoked Renaissance Verona with architectural elements that supported the play''s swift pacing and tragic inevitability, creating distinct spaces for the feuding families and the lovers'' secret meetings.\\n\\n**A Midsummer Night''s Dream** transformed the stage into an enchanted forest filled with magic, mischief, and romance. The scenic design created a dreamlike atmosphere that supported the play''s multiple plotlines—from the Athenian court to the fairy realm to the rustic mechanicals'' rehearsal space—all woven together in Shakespeare''s most fantastical comedy."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/GaBnXUBMoqfvKCua.jpg","caption":"A Midsummer Night''s Dream at Utah Shakespeare Festival, 2023. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. The enchanted forest setting with magical lighting effects. Photo courtesy Utah Shakespeare Festival."},{"type":"header","content":"Shakespeare in Repertory"},{"type":"text","content":"Working on two Shakespeare productions in the same season provided insight into how scenic design serves different dramatic modes—tragedy and comedy—while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic vocabulary. Both productions demonstrated Jo Winiarski''s ability to create environments that honor Shakespeare''s text while remaining visually compelling for contemporary audiences."},{"type":"header","content":"About Utah Shakespeare Festival"},{"type":"text","content":"The Utah Shakespeare Festival in Cedar City is one of the nation''s premier regional theatre companies, recipient of the Tony Award for Outstanding Regional Theatre. The Festival produces eight plays each summer in rotating repertory across three theatres, combining Shakespeare''s works with classic and contemporary plays and musicals."},{"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","label":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}]',
  90002,
  '2023-09-09',
  '2023-09-09',
  NOW()
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  title = VALUES(title),
  excerpt = VALUES(excerpt),
  coverImageUrl = VALUES(coverImageUrl),
  blocks = VALUES(blocks),
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  date = VALUES(date),
  publishedAt = VALUES(publishedAt);
